result.finding: No health checks are configured anywhere in the project. There is no HEALTHCHECK instruction in the Dockerfiles (generated at deploy time), no docker-compose healthcheck sections, no Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes, and no Spring Boot Actuator dependency in either module's pom.xml. No health endpoint code exists in the application source. This is a gap for cloud-native deployment readiness.
evidence: analyze.sh returned: no health checks found

No docker-compose.yml or Kubernetes manifests present
spring-boot-starter-actuator not present in web/pom.xml or worker/pom.xml
No /health, /actuator/health, /healthz or /ready endpoints found in source code
